notes: No hashes, IPs, domains or filenames were published for this campaign. This file therefore contains BEHAVIOURAL indicators only. Anyone offering you atomic IOCs for this incident is guessing.
Up to eight agents ran simultaneously, each working a different angle. Distinguishable from a threaded scanner because the parallel streams perform DIFFERENT actions, not the same action in parallel.
Machine-speed action bursts separated by 2-30s pauses matching LLM inference latency. Neither humans (slow, irregular) nor scripts (fast, uniform) produce this.
Tool continuously ranked and reprioritised attack paths on new evidence; on failure it searched the internet and devised a new approach. Scripts do not adapt; humans adapt slowly.
21 government systems mapped in four days WITH technique variation between them. Scanners are broad and uniform; humans are narrow and adaptive; agents are both.
Any non-workstation host resolving or connecting to a public model provider. Structural consequence of the technique, not an operator choice. Defeated by self-hosted inference.
Model API calls interleaved minute-by-minute with authentication activity from the same host. Highest-confidence single finding available.
Operators framed the campaign as an authorized penetration test, which the model had no reliable way to verify or reject. Observable ONLY at a gateway you operate.
